AppImage type2 runtime: https://github.com/AppImage/type2-runtime/commit/fedfad51acc2860b2916a1eef32ba4a500ff31ef
The runtime binary is unmodified. Sources, libfuse 3.15.0 (including original LGPL text), squashfuse 0.5.2, patches and build scripts are available in this release as appimage-runtime-sources.tar.gz. To replace/relink the runtime, build it with the provided scripts (Dockerfile / runtime Makefile), then pass the result to build_appimage.py --runtime-file YOUR_RUNTIME --appimagetool YOUR_APPIMAGETOOL. The AppDir payload can be extracted with --appimage-extract and used independently of the runtime.
